text.description_html:
Don-Jo CFK70, 3-1/2" x 15" Push Plate with Lock Cylinder Cut-out

This 3-1/2" wide x 15" high commercial door push plate has a cylinder hole cut-out perfect for adding a lock or lever. The 3-1/2" x 15" Push Plate with Hole is primarily used in commercial applications such as in restaurants, warehouses, factories, and stores. It is available in 4 different materials: Aluminum with a satin finish, stainless steel with a brushed stainless steel, brass with a polished brass finish, or bronze with an oil rubbed bronze finish.

Also available: Matching 3-1/2" x 15" Pull Plate with Hole

This commercial push plate is made in the USA by Don-Jo Manufacturing.

Specifications of Don-Jo CFK70 Push Plate with Cut-Out:

  • Plate Height: 15"
  • Plate Width: 3-1/2"
  • Hole Diameter: 2-1/8"
  • Hole is 1-3/4" on center from edge of plate.
  • Plate Thickness: .050" (1.2 mm)
  • Packaged with mounting screws.
  • Don-Jo CFK70 Dimensions (PDF)

When Selecting a Finish:

  • 628: Aluminum Pull Plate with Satin Aluminum Finish
  • 630: Stainless Steel Pull Plate with Satin Stainless Steel Finish
  • 605: Brass Pull Plate with Polished Brass Finish
  • 613: Bronze Pull Plate with Oil Rubbed Bonze Finish

*Sold Individually. Get a matching 3-1/2" x 15" Pull Plate with Cut-out
